narrative: Fire ecology and climate risk dominate today's crop: a new attribution study finds winter fire-weather risk in the southwestern United States has nearly doubled since 1984 as anthropogenic warming and Pacific Decadal Oscillation variability compound to weaken vegetation moisture buffers, while a Zimbabwe case study links land surface temperature and precipitation trends to changing wildfire regimes across savanna protected areas. Migration and movement research shows animals actively reshaping biogeochemistry and connectivity: GPS-tracked red deer transport nitrogen upslope in the Alps, redrawing landscape nutrient pools, while corridor-mapping across five large mammal species in southern India pinpoints fragmented pinch points outside protected areas as priorities for restoring connectivity. Trophic and herbivory work spans scales, from wolves and humans jointly shaping deer browsing pressure in Central European forests to invasive fish disrupting predator-prey size-spectrum relationships in freshwater communities, and mutualism studies show belowground rhizobium quality cascading up to shape aboveground herbivore survival. Restoration and conservation findings are broadly encouraging: rewetted temperate fens recover key vegetation and peat accumulation after decades of forestry drainage, and Mediterranean olive-grove restoration is closing a measurable recovery debt in pollinator communities. On the methods front, bioacoustic deep-learning pipelines and contrastive ecoacoustic embeddings are lowering the computational barrier to large-scale passive acoustic monitoring. Evolutionary biology contributions include evidence that whole-genome duplication in an alpine Brassicaceae promotes rather than forecloses adaptation to elevation, complementing landscape-scale work showing invasive Spartina populations in China have evolved distinct, more vigorously defended trait syndromes since introduction.

methods_radar.title: N‐SDM 2.0: a reengineered software with extended features for nested species distribution modelling
methods_radar.note: Introduces N-SDM 2.0, a reengineered software package with extended features for nested species distribution modelling.

methods_radar.title: EverWatch airborne bird imagery dataset for detection and classification of Everglades wading birds
methods_radar.note: Introduces EverWatch, an airborne imagery dataset for training computer-vision detection of Everglades wading birds.

methods_radar.title: Hierarchical Modelling of Aquatic Species Distributions
methods_radar.note: Introduces novel hierarchical global-to-regional model structures for species distribution modelling in aquatic systems.

methods_radar.title: Addressing Data Fragmentation in Biodiversity: A Workflow for Integrated Species Distribution Models
methods_radar.note: Introduces an integrated workflow combining fragmented datasets for large-scale biodiversity distribution mapping.

methods_radar.title: Bacpipe: A Python package to make bioacoustic deep learning models accessible
methods_radar.note: Introduces Bacpipe, a Python package bundling bioacoustic deep-learning models behind a graphical interface.

methods_radar.title: From fluke to fragment: A multifaceted method for molecular sex identification and mitochondrial haplotyping from environmental DNA samples
methods_radar.note: Introduces a multifaceted method for molecular sex identification and mitochondrial haplotyping from environmental DNA.

methods_radar.title: The PhenoChange network protocol for monitoring leaf phenology in tropical dry ecosystems using phenocameras
methods_radar.note: Introduces the PhenoChange network protocol for monitoring tropical dry-forest leaf phenology using phenocameras.

methods_radar.title: ESO: An evolutionary algorithm for efficient model reduction via automated frequency band selection in passive acoustic monitoring
methods_radar.note: Introduces ESO, an evolutionary algorithm automating frequency-band selection to shrink bioacoustic classifier models.

methods_radar.title: Contrastive ecoacoustic indices: Large‐scale global soundscape characterization with contrastive inference
methods_radar.note: Introduces contrastive language-audio pretraining (CLAP) to ecoacoustics for annotation-free soundscape characterization.

methods_radar.title: An efficient Bayesian phylogenetic approach for joint inference of continuous and discrete trait evolution under a state‐dependent Ornstein–Uhlenbeck model
methods_radar.note: Introduces an efficient Bayesian phylogenetic method for joint inference under a state-dependent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model.

methods_radar.title: Observer coverage and interaction rates determine the choice between design‐based and machine learning bycatch estimators for rare species
methods_radar.note: Benchmarks design-based versus machine-learning bycatch estimators for rare protected-species encounters.

methods_radar.title: Using Integrated Species Distribution Models to Improve Range Size Metrics for IUCN Red List Assessments
methods_radar.note: Benchmarks integrated species distribution models against presence-only SDMs for IUCN range-size metrics.

methods_radar.title: Facilitating macrosystem biology with organismal‐scale airborne remote sensing: Challenges and opportunities
methods_radar.note: Reviews and advances the application of organismal-scale airborne remote sensing to macrosystem-level ecological questions.

methods_radar.title: An integrated land-use reclassification and scenario-simulation analysis of land system dynamics in China
methods_radar.note: Advances a land-use reclassification and scenario-simulation framework distinguishing ecologically distinct land-system transitions in China.

methods_radar.title: Including linear landscape elements improves fine-scale species distribution models of bees and hoverflies

methods_radar.title: Enhanced fish detection sensitivity in aquatic systems using environmental RNA
methods_radar.note: Advances environmental RNA as a fish-detection tool, testing sensitivity and legacy-signal advantages over eDNA.

methods_radar.note: Benchmarks taxonomic classification methods for DNA barcodes lacking species-level reference matches.

methods_radar.title: Leveraging time-series remote sensing to predict post-fire invasive annual grass response in western US rangelands

methods_radar.title: Intermediate habitat fragmentation reduces gastropod movement in experimental intertidal landscapes: implications for fragmentation–diversity relationships
methods_radar.note: Applies drone surveys and mark-recapture in experimental intertidal landscapes to test fragmentation-driven dispersal limitation.

methods_radar.title: Nonlinear associations between comprehensive ecosystem services and four compound climate extremes: a comparative analysis across China from 2000 to 2020

methods_radar.title: Genomic Tracking of Market‐Derived Bull Shark Fins Back to Source Population of Origin

methods_radar.title: Protecting tropical forests is more cost-effective for biodiversity and climate than restoration
methods_radar.note: Applies field assessment and remote sensing to compare cost-effectiveness of forest protection versus restoration.
